changelog: Trailers: a failed download or transcode now records what yt-dlp or ffmpeg actually said, visible in OrcaEngine/Trailer/Diagnostics and the server log. Failed titles are no longer retried on every card focus: a temporary failure waits 5 minutes, doubling up to a day, and a title with no trailer is retried weekly. ffmpeg can no longer stall on its own log output until the timeout. Requires Jellyfin 12.1 or later. This is a beta release.
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
name: Orca Engine
